note: Both sets erroneously interpret the legend key '3' found inside the module symbols as a specific data value (e.g., quantity or voltage), resulting in numerous unsupported claims. Set B is preferred because it correctly extracts the full cable specification ('USE-2') and captures significant components like the Junction Box model and Planter Equipment connection which Set A misses. Set A contains a higher volume of incorrect value bindings and truncates the cable type specification.
